Bug_Details: The type of the array parameter of Collection.toArray needs to be compatible with the array type
Bug_Explanation: The 'toArray' method of the Collection interface takes an array as a parameter to be used as the return type. The size of this array dictates the size of the returned array. If the array is too small, the method will return an array of the specified size with the elements from the collection. If the array is too large, the method will return an array of the specified size with the first 'n' elements from the collection, where 'n' is the size of the array. If the array size is exactly the size of the collection, then there is no problem. In this case, the bug is that the array is too small for the collection.
